اقتويتما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَوَيْتُمَا (iqtawaytumā) /iq.ta.waj.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اُقْتُوِيتُمَا (uqtuwītumā) /uq.tu.wiː.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
